flawless: I named your best card before you drew it. Your whole plan was an open book to me.
Peace is kept by those who know what is coming. I knew everything.
Order prevailed without a single wound. As it is written.
solid: You found the cards I didn't name. A small mercy for you, and a small lesson for me.
The peace held, though you strained it. Benalia's law endures.
close: I named the wrong card, and you very nearly made me regret it.
My vision blurred near the end. Thank the Church I saw just enough.
